data.title: 丰川祥子 · 客服电话结束的一秒
data.description: 客服办公区里，祥子穿浅蓝衬衫与工作开衫，坐在电脑显示器前结束一通电话。她抬手将耳麦的麦克风移开，另一只手停在普通鼠标上，职业微笑慢慢放松；屏幕只有模糊表格，桌面便签和水杯整齐排好。
data.action: 结束客服来电后移开耳麦话筒，手停在电脑鼠标上。
data.promptProse: Sakiko Togawa finishes the call at her computer workstation, moving the headset microphone away while the other hand stays on the mouse. Her pale-blue blouse and work cardigan remain orderly as the professional smile relaxes into fatigue. The medium portrait includes indistinct forms on the monitor, neatly arranged notes and a water cup. Soft cool office light illuminates blue hair and yellow eyes, with restrained equipment shadows across the practical desk.
